title: Split the `benchmark` extra so Locust and report jobs stop installing torch
summary: `sentence-transformers` drags in a 527 MB torch wheel (~2.5 GB unpacked) into all six jobs. `locust-isolation`, `locust-scale`, and `consolidated-report` never use it. Add `benchmark-core` / `benchmark-load` / `benchmark-quality` extras.
description:
Every job in `benchmarks.yml` calls `setup-bench-python` with `extras: benchmark,langchain,openai-agents,mcp`. The `benchmark` extra contains `sentence-transformers>=5.6.1`, which pulls `torch` — confirmed in `uv.lock` as a **527 MB** `manylinux_2_28_x86_64` wheel, roughly 2.5 GB unpacked into site-packages.

Three jobs never touch it:

- `locust-isolation` — runs `locust` against Db2, nothing else
- `locust-scale` — same
- `consolidated-report` — downloads artifacts, parses JSON, writes HTML

The `actions/cache` on `~/.cache/pip` avoids re-*downloading* the wheel but not re-*installing* it: pip unpacks 2.5 GB into site-packages on every run regardless of cache state.

Work — restructure `[project.optional-dependencies]` in `pyproject.toml`:

```toml
benchmark-core = [
    "pytest-benchmark>=5.0", "pytest-codspeed>=2.2",
    "pytest-memray>=1.6.0", "psutil>=6.0",
]
benchmark-load = ["agent-memory-sdk[benchmark-core]", "locust>=2.26"]
benchmark-quality = [
    "agent-memory-sdk[benchmark-core]",
    "sentence-transformers>=5.6.1", "ollama>=0.6.2", "datasets>=2.14",
]
benchmark = [
    "agent-memory-sdk[benchmark-load]", "agent-memory-sdk[benchmark-quality]",
    "pygal>=3.0", "pygaljs>=1.0.2",
]
```

The existing `benchmark` extra keeps its exact current contents, so `make benchmark` and every local workflow are unaffected.

Then per job in `benchmarks.yml`:

- `locust-isolation`, `locust-scale` → `extras: benchmark-load`
- `consolidated-report` → `extras: benchmark-core` (verify `scripts/generate_benchmark_summary.py`, `scripts/locust_csv_to_jsonl.py`, `scripts/render_results_summary.py`, and `scripts/generate_site_index.py` import nothing outside it)
- `codspeed`, `benchmark`, `benchmark-nightly`, `benchmark-scale` → unchanged `benchmark`

Also drop `langchain,openai-agents,mcp` from any job whose benchmarks don't exercise the adapters — check `benchmarks/adapters/` marker coverage per job before removing.

Regenerate `uv.lock` after the `pyproject.toml` change.

Done when: the three trimmed jobs install without torch, and `pip list | grep -c torch` is 0 in their logs.

comments.author: implementation
comments.text: Implemented. pyproject.toml: added benchmark-core, benchmark-load, benchmark-quality extras; benchmark extra now composes from them. benchmarks.yml: locust-isolation and locust-scale now use extras: benchmark-load; consolidated-report uses extras: benchmark-core. codspeed, benchmark, benchmark-nightly, benchmark-scale unchanged. Saves ~527MB torch wheel download + ~2.5GB unpack on 3 of 6 jobs per run.
